en: In John 15, by what had Jesus already pruned, or cleansed, his disciples?
In John 18, what did Jesus cross with his disciples to reach the garden?
In John 19, on which plant was the soaked sponge raised to Jesus' mouth?
In John 20, what was shut where the disciples were when Jesus appeared?
In John 21, besides fish, what food was waiting for the disciples on shore?
